summary: Pre-Vote update modeled (MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED); harness rebased; 23 fresh traces validated. Model checking found two update defects, both reproduced on the real runtime: MC-1 (a stale Pre-Vote round makes a newly elected leader call elect(); debug panic / release demotion) and MC-2 (a delayed grant from an earlier same-term round panics grant_by after a membership change). Also recorded: pre-existing CR-PRE-1, doc mismatch D-3, unresolved D-2.
validation_limits: All model-checking campaigns are bounded (3 nodes, MaxTerm 2, MaxLogIndex 4, bounded elections/pre-vote starts/membership changes/crash/drop/messages) and budget-terminated BFS runs are LIMITED_COVERAGE, not exhaustive.
Engine-level traces drive real Engine methods; runtime command execution between events is replayed by the harness (documented in instrumentation-spec.md).
Election-timer timing, RPC timeouts and round rate limiting are abstracted; the automatic (tick) trigger of MC-1 additionally needs vote-persist latency within the timeout window.
Builds use stable rustc 1.100.0; the pinned nightly toolchain is unavailable.
PreVoteElectionByVoter (D-2) has no non-implementation requirement evidence and remains unresolved; it was disabled in the continued hunts after its counterexamples were recorded.

findings.title: Stale Pre-Vote round survives the node's own election win and makes the new Leader call elect()
findings.cause: pre_elect runs while a real candidate is active; establish_leader/become_leader never clear pre_candidate, and handle_pre_vote_resp elects on quorum without checking the node is still a would-be candidate.
findings.trigger: A Candidate starts a Pre-Vote round (tick after election timeout, or trigger().elect(true)) while its vote RPCs are in flight; a late vote grant makes it Leader; a Pre-Vote grant for that round then arrives.
findings.consequence: The new Leader abandons its term and becomes a term+1 Candidate while keeping its Leader object; in debug builds RaftCore panics at engine_impl.rs:977, in release builds the leader is demoted and followers holding its lease reject the new election.

premises: Pre-Vote can start while a real candidate is active (tick on a timed-out Candidate or trigger().elect(true)).
The runtime filter matches Pre-Vote responses by leader id only.

findings.title: Delayed Pre-Vote grant from an earlier same-term round panics RaftCore after a membership change
findings.cause: Pre-Vote responses are matched only by the probe leader id, which every round at an unchanged term reuses; Candidate::grant_by expects the responder to be a voter of the current round's frozen membership.
findings.trigger: Start a Pre-Vote round (trigger().elect(true)), remove a node whose grant is still in flight, start another round at the same term; the old grant arrives.
findings.consequence: grant_by panics with 'target not in quorum set' (proposer/candidate.rs:107) and RaftCore stops with Fatal::Panicked.

premises: Two Pre-Vote rounds at the same vote term reuse one probe leader id.
A responder removed between the rounds still answers the first round within the RPC timeout.

findings.title: Operator election trigger on the current Leader leaves a stale Leader object (debug panic)
findings.cause: ExternalCommand::Elect calls elect() on a Leader; do_elect keeps the Leader object while the vote becomes an uncommitted term+1 self vote.
findings.trigger: raft.trigger().elect() (old) or elect(false) (new) on the node that is currently Leader.
findings.consequence: try_leader_handler's debug_assert fails and RaftCore panics (both revisions); pre-existing, not introduced by the update.

findings.title: Pre-Vote protocol documentation contradicts the default pre_vote RPC and Unreachable handling
findings.cause: pre_vote.md says the default pre_vote returns Unreachable and Unreachable counts as a grant; the code synthesizes a grant and never counts transport errors.
findings.trigger: An implementor follows pre_vote.md and returns Unreachable from an unimplemented pre_vote.
findings.consequence: With Pre-Vote enabled such a node can never assemble a Pre-Vote quorum (it would rely on Unreachable being a grant).

findings.title: Pre-Vote quorum can make a node elect after it stopped being a voter
findings.cause: The voter check is done when the round starts (tick/ExternalCommand); handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() without re-checking.
findings.trigger: A node holding a round (Leader via operator elect(true), or the MC-1 path) removes itself from the voters before the quorum arrives.
findings.consequence: A non-voter bumps its term and queues vote requests; only implementation evidence says non-voters must not elect (a learner may lead), so the requirement is unresolved.
